title: Cinema Paradiso
description: A Sicilian boy (Salvatore Cascio) discovers the movies with his local theater's projectionist (Philippe Noiret).

title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
description: A 1930s movie star (Jeff Daniels) steps off the screen to join a waitress (Mia Farrow) in the audience.

title: Sherlock, Jr.
description: After a day of playing amateur sleuth, a movie projectionist "projects" himself into a film to solve a case.

title: A Little Romance
description: A worldly Parisian (Laurence Olivier) tells two teenage lovers (Diane Lane, Thelonious Bernard) to kiss at dusk under the Bridge of Sighs in Venice.

title: Last Summer
description: An independent teenager (Barbara Hershey) uses her sexuality to encourage two friends (Richard Thomas, Bruce Davison) to rape a girl whom they all ridicule.

title: The Master of Ballantrae
description: Two Scottish brothers engage in fierce sibling rivalry while battling pirates, Indians and British soldiers.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: Court followers foil a royal plot by having a look-alike English tourist (Stewart Granger) pose as the king of Ruritania.

title: The Lost City
description:
S01 E05 — Tiger Prey
An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

title: Dark Delusion
description: Dr. Gillespie's (Lionel Barrymore) young colleague (James Craig) treats an heiress (Lucille Bremer) for insanity against her family's wishes.

title: Out-Foxed
description: Droopy is a highly civilized fox-hound.

title: The Three Little Pups
description: A lazy wolf targets Droopy and friends.

title: Interrupted Melody
description: Australian soprano Marjorie Lawrence (Eleanor Parker) makes a comeback after being disabled by polio.

title: White Heat
description: A brave federal agent poses as a thug to infiltrate psychopathic hoodlum Cody Jarrett's gang of thieves.

title: San Antonio
description: A Texas cattleman (Errol Flynn) flirts with a saloon singer (Alexis Smith) and shoots it out with rustlers at the Alamo.

title: Take the High Ground
description: Two Army sergeants (Richard Widmark, Karl Malden) use different methods to produce soldiers at Fort Bliss, Texas.

title: American Pop
description: Young immigrant Zalmie arrives in New York City and becomes addicted to show business. When an accident ruins his voice, he marries a stripper and their son, Benny, becomes a jazz pianist.

title: Fame
description: Leroy, Coco (Irene Cara), Bruno (Lee Curreri) and others of mixed talents and means attend New York's High School of Performing Arts.

title: Nora Prentiss
description: A nightclub singer (Ann Sheridan) inspires a doctor (Kent Smith) to fake his own murder, for which he stands trial.

title: Jack L. Warner: The Last Mogul
description: Rising from humble beginnings, Jack L. Warner and his brothers make movie history by founding Warner Bros. Studios.

title: To Have and Have Not
description: A boat skipper (Humphrey Bogart) flirts with a singer (Lauren Bacall) and fools Nazis on the island of Martinique.

title: Ladies They Talk About
description: A district attorney feels a strong attraction for an imprisoned gun moll who rises to the top of the prison ladder.

title: Lady Gangster
description: A radio-station owner (Frank Wilcox) tries to reform a small-town girl (Faye Emerson) who has fallen in with mobsters.

title: Lady Scarface
description: A police detective (Dennis O'Keefe) and his photographer girlfriend (Frances Neal) hunt a gang led by a woman (Judith Anderson).

title: Nora Prentiss
description: A nightclub singer (Ann Sheridan) inspires a doctor (Kent Smith) to fake his own murder, for which he stands trial.

title: The Secret Garden
description: An English orphan (Margaret O'Brien) finds the key to her bitter uncle's (Herbert Marshall) magic garden, seen in color.

title: The Great Sinner
description: A lucky writer (Gregory Peck) tries to get his girlfriend (Ava Gardner) and her gambler father out of debt to a casino owner (Melvyn Douglas).

title: Marriage on the Rocks
description: An adman's (Frank Sinatra) wife (Deborah Kerr) winds up wed to his buddy (Dean Martin) after a quickie Mexican divorce and marriage.

title: Boys' Night Out
description: Would-be swingers Fred (James Garner), George (Tony Randall), Doug and Howard share a sexy blonde (Kim Novak) who's secretly doing a thesis on men.

title: Incendiary Blonde
description: Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) goes from Broadway to Hollywood to nightclub hostess in Roaring '20s New York.

title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
description: A bank clerk (Eddie Bracken) gets in trouble after posing as the unknown GI father of his girlfriend's (Betty Hutton) sextuplets.

title: The Enchanted Cottage
description: When a disabled World War I veteran moves to a small cottage, he meets a plain and kind woman.

title: News From Home
description: Sweeping scenes of New York City contrasted to the letters from the director's mother in Brussels.

title: Les rendez-vous d'Anna
description: Anna meets many people on her trip to Germany to show her latest film, and they all make personal revelations to her.

title: Born to Kill
description: A private eye (Walter Slezak) hunts a killer (Lawrence Tierney) who marries a divorcee's (Claire Trevor) rich sister.

title: D.O.A.
description: A dying accountant (Edmond O'Brien) has a few days left to find out who spiked his drink with poison and why.

title: Race Street
description: A police detective (William Bendix) and a bookie (George Raft) bust a protection racket in San Francisco.

title: Woman on the Run
description: A woman (Ann Sheridan) searches San Francisco for her husband, the hunted witness to a gangland execution.

title: Impact
description: A declared-dead man (Brian Donlevy) hides out with a widow (Ella Raines) after his wife and her lover botch his murder.

title: Blonde Ice
description: A society reporter (Leslie Brooks) kills men for fame and money, then tries to frame a sportswriter (Robert Paige).

title: Dark Passage
description: A San Francisco art student (Lauren Bacall) hides a fugitive (Humphrey Bogart) recovering from underworld plastic surgery.

title: The Maltese Falcon
description: Private eye Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) encounters sundry characters (Mary Astor, Peter Lorre), all seeking a coveted statuette.

title: Stormy Weather
description: A veteran entertainer (Bill Robinson) recalls his wife (Lena Horne), his colleagues and his career from 1911 to 1936.

title: A Song Is Born
description: A think-tank professor (Danny Kaye) studying jazz falls for a gangster's girlfriend (Virginia Mayo) on the run.

title: Reveille With Beverly
description: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie.

title: Hollywood Hotel
description: The winner of a talent contest travels to Hollywood but finds the road to stardom more difficult than he expected.

title: Ship Ahoy
description: A hack writer (Red Skelton) and his sidekick (Bert Lahr) meet a tap dancer (Eleanor Powell) duped by Axis spies on a cruise to Puerto Rico.

title: Du Barry Was a Lady
description: A nightclub guy (Red Skelton) slips himself a Mickey and dreams that he is French King Louis XV, with a singer (Lucille Ball) as Madame Du Barry.

title: The Old Man and the Sea
description: Hemingway's old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) in a small wooden boat relives his youth as he fights a huge marlin.

title: Captains Courageous
description: Portuguese fishermen pick up a rich man's son (Freddie Bartholomew) who has fallen overboard.

title: Malaya
description: A former reporter (James Stewart) and a paroled smuggler (Spencer Tracy) sneak tons of World War II rubber past the Japanese.
